aggregations.average: valid-angle pooled, equal to valid-sample mean because each valid request has22angles
aggregations.literal_hand: original helper FP32 per-joint mean and hand mean, recorded separately
aggregations.native_auxiliary: FP32 batch1 mean including zero loss for invalid requests; never substituted for Avg
aggregations.splits: unweighted valid per-user means; population SD ddof=0; left/right pooled within user
